## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-normalized`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-normalized -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `manifest.parquet`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `manifest.parquet`
- `data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-normalized at revision `3aa070c863324edaa9d82f762b8268ddb8e092a2`, made 2026-10-15. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC normalised — every bank in one schema

> **Start here — free verify:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) (or the free MCP tool `verify_card` at `https://councilof.ai/mcp`) · **Full catalog:** [https://councilof.ai/catalog.json](https://councilof.ai/catalog.json) · Methodology: [https://councilof.ai/methodology/](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · Measurement, not certification.

**The one schema to read first.** 518 rows that flatten several GSPC banks into a
single shape: `source` (the bank repository the row came from), `axis`, `category`, `anchor`, `prompt`,
`expected`, `expected_is_list`, and `raw_keys` recording the original row's keys so nothing is silently
dropped. If you want to reuse the banks without learning each one's native layout, start here.

## What is in this repository

| file | bytes | rows | what |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet` | 56817 |  | data (Parquet) |
| `README.md` | 1498 |  | card |
| `eval.yaml` | 511 |  | config |
| `manifest.jsonl` | | 4 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |

`manifest.parquet` is derived from this repository's own file tree at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z; it lists every file with its
size, its blob hash and a direct URL, so an agent can enumerate the repo without cloning it.
